results.name: B1 reflowable pages: columns paginate, Next / ArrowRight move one page width, the end of a part goes on, the position is restored on reopen
B2 contents: clicking an entry shows that part
B3 search: hits are listed; a hit opens its part with a visible <mark>
B4 safety: book scripts and handlers never run, no allow-scripts, CSP meta present; an external link asks first and Cancel opens nothing
B5 right-to-left page progression: ArrowLeft advances, ArrowRight goes back
B6 fixed layout: the 900×600 viewport is scaled to fit; a spread puts page-spread-left on the left; spread none shows one page
B8 an obfuscated font loads after de-obfuscation; the wrong-key variant does not
B9 Dark theme and a larger font reach the frame
B10 manifest images decode under the frame CSP; an image missing from the manifest is not shown
B11 a malformed chapter shows an error message instead of guessed content
B12 roll layout: all parts are stacked in one vertical scroller
B14 Shell: a file opened after a reload loads even when a restored window holds the same id (w1_books) — it was focused instead and the file never loaded
B15 an in-book link (data-epub-href) opens its target part through the frame listener; the frame itself never navigates
B16 visual: reflowable page and a fixed-layout spread render (screenshots for inspection)
B13 no page errors were thrown by the app during the suite
